description:
One blueprint's whole setup in English: every action's definition in
full, the record types, web endpoints, schedules, sign-in, payments
and MCP server it declares, what it cannot do, and what the person
does after it starts. Read it before start_from_blueprint, and tell
the person which rule they will most likely want to change.
